name: mingxu
description: 命序 MingXu：本地优先的八字、紫微斗数、大六壬、真太阳时与 AI Agent 结构化计算工具

scripts.test:migration: node --test tools/recovery.test.mjs tools/address-switch.test.mjs && npm run build:mcp && npm run build -w @mingxu/render && node --test tools/compat.test.mjs && node --test --import tsx apps/web/test/backup.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mingxu/core && npm run build -w @mingxu/prompt && npm run build -w @mingxu/render && npm run build -w @mingxu/agent-tools && npm run build -w @mingxu/mcp && npm run build -w @mingxu/web
scripts.build:mcp: npm run build -w @mingxu/core && npm run build -w @mingxu/prompt && npm run build -w @mingxu/agent-tools && npm run build -w @mingxu/mcp
scripts.test: npm run test -w @mingxu/core && npm run build -w @mingxu/core && npm run test -w @mingxu/prompt && npm run build -w @mingxu/prompt && npm run test -w @mingxu/agent-tools && npm run build -w @mingxu/agent-tools && npm run test -w @mingxu/mcp && npm run test -w @mingxu/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mingxu/core && npm run build -w @mingxu/prompt && npm run build -w @mingxu/render && npm run build -w @mingxu/agent-tools && npm run typecheck -w @mingxu/web && npm run typecheck -w @mingxu/mcp && npm run typecheck:api
